letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Even the desert breeze feels softer when you’re near, and the monsoon’s gentle patter sings our love song. I cherish our laughter echoing through bustling streets and quiet evenings on the balcony, where you, my cutie, turn ordinary moments into timeless memories. Here’s to another day of us, hand in hand, heart to heart—forever yours, now and always.
poem:
In sunrise gold or monsoon’s sigh,  
Your smile outshines the bluest sky.  
Across two homes, our love does glide,  
Together, forever, side by side.
